summary: ArcBest Corporation (ARCB) filed an 8-K/A to correct a clerical error on the cover page of its initial 8-K, which had misstated the state of incorporation as Delaware instead of Texas. The initial report disclosed the company's conversion from Delaware to Texas. This amendment solely fixes that typo and does not update any other disclosure. There are no special-situation terms such as price, premium, or deal mechanics. It is a routine administrative correction with no investment implications.
